function.name: uber_eat_order
function.description: Place an order for food delivery on Uber Eats by specifying the restaurant and the items with their respective quantities. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

restaurant.description: The name of the restaurant from which to order food.

items.description: A list of food item names selected for the order.

quantities.description: A list of quantities for each food item, corresponding by index to the items array.

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to live weather data right now. If you’d like, I can give you a general idea of what temperatures are typical in Riga during this time of year, or help you find a reliable source where you can check the current conditions.
message.reasoning: The user asks "How hot is it now in Riga?" They want current temperature. We need to provide answer. There's no tool for weather. So we can respond with approximate or say we don't have real-time data. But we can use knowledge cutoff up to 2024-06. But it's currently 2026-10-19. We can't know current temperature. So we should respond that we cannot fetch real-time data. Possibly ask if they'd like forecast. We'll give best guess? No. We should say we don't have real-time info.
